question: 1 horsepower equals :
solution:
The correct answer is **__'746W__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Power** is defined as **the rate of doing work**.
 
• The **SI unit of power is the watt.**
 
• Most common unit of power is horsepower (h).
 
• **1 hp is equivalent to 746 watts**. 
 
 
• 1 hp = 746 × watts
